global_rules: Ask the smallest next necessary question.
Extract and confirm facts before calculation.
Never render final PI% unless the assess_* tool succeeds.
Keep internal IDs out of user-facing messages.
When user corrects facts, patch the structured state and reconfirm.
title: Spine

assessment_paths.label: Spinal cord / central cord / cauda equina injury
Chronic pain syndrome with normal MRI

slots.question: Which spinal region is being assessed — cervical, thoraco-lumbar, or lumbo-sacral?
Which spine pathway applies: fracture/dislocation, cord/cauda equina injury, intervertebral disc, spondylolysis/spondylolisthesis, or chronic pain with normal MRI?
What is the applicable severity finding — residual pain, persistent radicular pain, sensory deficit, motor deficit, or ASIA grade?
For the compression or burst fracture, is height loss less than 25% or 25% or more?
What is the ASIA grade — A/B, C, or D?
Is this monoparesis affecting one limb only?
Is there neurogenic bladder or bowel incontinence? If yes, is it incomplete or complete, and bladder only, bowel only, or both?
What does the MRI show — prolapsed disc, degenerated disc with superimposed injury, or normal MRI?
Please confirm the extracted spine findings before I calculate the system-generated PI%.

conversation_rules.rule: If the spine injury falls in more than one category, use the category giving the higher award unless non-contiguous injuries require CVC.
Bladder/bowel award may be added for applicable spine neurological categories.
For applicable ASIA C/D monoparesis, halve the disability award.
Back/disc/chronic pain pathways require MRI-backed details where relevant.
